long_description: Backstory is an AI revenue platform designed for sales teams. It captures activity from emails, meetings, and chats to identify deal risk, monitor pipeline health, and assist with revenue forecasting.
Cognigy powers enterprise customer service with generative and conversational AI agents across voice and chat, enabling automated, scalable support solutions.
CustomGPT is a no-code platform that empowers businesses to create custom AI agents using their own content and knowledge bases, without any coding skills required.
notIdealFor: Developers looking for API-first LLM orchestration
